summary: grill-with-docs: the B1-vs-B2 design was settled by an 8-agent design+verify workflow + ADR 0012. Chose B2 (separate post-merge closeout PR) because B1 (self-contained impl PR) conflicts with the loop's review->CCA->merge->done ordering, and #149 empirically proved a pure-bookkeeping closeout PR obtains a complete CCA verdict. Scoped to single-task / last-task; multi-task deferred. Recorded in docs/adr/0012-autonomous-loop-closeout-to-main.md.
